scale: Capability scores: 3 = built in (native), 2 = set up without code (configurable / built-in integration needing setup or higher plan), 1 = add-on, partner app or Zapier, 0 = not offered. For shared columns use the specific rules given.

shared.r: 3 = permanent free plan usable for real work; 2 = free trial only (no card or card); 1 = demo only / paid pilot; 0 = none.
3 = native app/add-in for BOTH Microsoft 365 (Outlook/Teams/Word) and Google Workspace (Gmail/Docs/Meet); 2 = native for one of them; 1 = only via Zapier/Make or copy-paste; 0 = no.
3 = French interface AND produces/understands French well (support for Quebec clients); 2 = French output/understanding but English-only interface; 1 = partial or beta French; 0 = English only.
